title: In the all-customers state a filter change keeps every customer included, including newly-appearing ones
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. You are on the report in the all-customers state.
2. A customer exists that has invoices ONLY in a wider date range than the current one (seed a ZZAUTOTEST invoice dated last month if needed).
steps: 1. With the current (narrow) date range, confirm that customer is not shown.
2. Widen the date range so that customer's invoice now matches.
3. Check the table and the Customer filter label.
expected: 1. The filter stays in the all-customers state (label still "All customers").
2. Every customer matching the new filters is included — including the newly-present customer, without any manual re-selection.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: The explicit all-customers flag (rather than an enumeration of ids) is the 2026-07-21 committed target — BUILD-DELTA possible at VIU.
